# RankForge

> RankForge provides free browser-based SEO and GEO tools that run entirely on the user's device. No sign-up required. Tools include meta tag generator, headline analyzer, word counter, slug generator, robots.txt generator, keyword density checker, readability score checker, text case converter, password generator, lorem ipsum generator, AI readiness checker, GEO score checker, schema markup generator, XML sitemap generator, heading structure checker, hreflang generator, canonical URL generator and llms.txt generator. The site also publishes plain-English beginner guides on SEO and Generative Engine Optimization.

RankForge is privacy-first: nothing users type is sent to a server. All tools work on mobile and desktop.

## Tools

- [Meta Tag Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/meta-tag-generator): Create title, description and Open Graph tags with a live Google preview
- [Headline Analyzer](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/headline-analyzer): Score a headline for length, word balance and power words
- [Word & Character Counter](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/word-counter): Count words, characters, sentences and estimate reading time
- [Slug Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/slug-generator): Turn any title into a clean SEO-friendly URL slug
- [Robots.txt Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/robots-txt-generator): Build crawl rules and download a robots.txt file
- [Keyword Density Checker](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/keyword-density-checker): See the most used words and their share of the text
- [Readability Score Checker](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/readability-score-checker): Get Flesch Reading Ease score and grade level
- [Text Case Converter](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/text-case-converter): Convert text to upper, lower, title or sentence case
- [Password Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/password-generator): Create strong random passwords in the browser
- [Lorem Ipsum Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator): Generate placeholder text for designs
- [AI Readiness Checker](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/ai-readiness-checker): Check how ready a page is for AI search answers
- [Canonical URL Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/canonical-url-generator): Generate a clean self-referencing canonical tag with HTTPS, lowercase and tracking parameters removed
- [GEO Score Checker](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/geo-score-checker): Score any content 0-100 for AI-search readiness
- [Heading Structure Checker](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/heading-structure-checker): Check heading hierarchy, spot a missing H1, skipped levels and order problems
- [Hreflang Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/hreflang-generator): Generate hreflang link tags for language and regional page versions
- [LLMs.txt Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/llms-txt-generator): Generate a clean llms.txt file that tells AI systems how to use and cite your content
- [Schema Markup Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/schema-markup-generator): Generate valid JSON-LD schema for Article, FAQ, Organization, Product and LocalBusiness
- [XML Sitemap Generator](https://rankforgetool.com/tools/xml-sitemap-generator): Paste page URLs and generate a valid XML sitemap.xml

- [What Is an XML Sitemap and How to Create One](https://rankforgetool.com/blog/what-is-an-xml-sitemap-and-how-to-create-one): What an XML sitemap is, why it matters, and how to create and submit one

- [What Is Keyword Density? A Simple Guide](https://rankforgetool.com/blog/what-is-keyword-density-and-how-to-use-keywords): What keyword density means, why there is no perfect percentage, and how to check for overuse
- [What Is an llms.txt File and Should You Add One in 2026?](https://rankforgetool.com/blog/what-is-llms-txt-and-should-you-add-one): What an llms.txt file is, how it differs from robots.txt, and when it helps with GEO
- [What Is Lorem Ipsum and When Should You Use It?](https://rankforgetool.com/blog/what-is-lorem-ipsum-and-when-to-use-placeholder-text): Where lorem ipsum comes from and when placeholder text helps designers
- [What Is a Robots.txt File? How to Create One](https://rankforgetool.com/blog/what-is-robots-txt-and-how-to-create-one): What robots.txt does, how its rules work, and how to create and test your own file
- [What Is Schema Markup and How to Add It for SEO and GEO](https://rankforgetool.com/blog/what-is-schema-markup-and-how-to-add-it): What schema markup is, why it matters for Google and AI answer engines, and how to add valid JSON-LD
